events.description: We Shred Rock Creek is back for 2026 – and it is shaping up to be one heck of a good time on bikes. Whether you’re looking to progress, try a new trail, ride Rock Creek (or any bike park!) for the first time, or just meet other rad women+ and girls who ride, this event is for you! Women+ and Girls Take Over Rock Creek! No matter your skill level, showing up and riding any mountain bike park can be a little intimidating, especially if you don't have a friend to ride with. events.title: Pisgah DOUBLE DARE
events.description: Every year an event comes along that tests mental and physical strengths of its racers like no other. Pisgah Productions proudly presents the hardest (and most fun) thing you will do this year….. the DOUBLE DARE. Teams of two riders will race to reach up to 10 checkpoints (CPs) per day, two days in a row. The race begins at 10AM on Saturday and every team must be back before 10PM. The race resumes at 6AM Sunday with 10 brand new checkpoints. Every team must finish before 6PM on Sunday. Teams ‘in the running’ should expect up to 70 miles of riding with 12,000-15,000 feet of climbing each day. SINGLE-DARE! The one-day category at Double-Dare!!! Teams of two riders will race up to 10 checkpoints, in any order, and return to the start/finish the fastest. Checkpoint locations will remain secret

events.title: Bootlegger
events.description: The Bootlegger is one of the most challenging and scenic gravel events of the year! There are two route choices (58 and 85 miles) that both start and finish in downtown Lenoir, NC and travel through the beautiful and rugged Wilson Creek Gorge. The 58 mile route has approximately 4500 feet of climbing while the 85 includes approximately 7250 feet of climbing. Be sure to keep your head up and enjoy the scenery as the Bootlegger 100 takes you from historic downtown Lenoir and into the heart of the “other Pisgah,” also known as the Grandfather Ranger District. Both the 85 and 58 mile options roll through the countryside before delivering you to a gravel wonderland with plenty of challenging terrain. events.title: Pisgah Mountain Bike Adventure Race
events.description: The Pisgah Mountain Bike Adventure Race (PMBAR) is the absolute pinnacle of MTB Adventure Racing. A mix of brutal and beautiful, this test of spirit and camaraderie tasks teams of two racers to reach 4 of 5 checkpoints, in any order, and return to the start/finish as fast as possible. The team with the lowest overall time wins. Checkpoint locations remain secret until start-time and there is no suggested route. Routes vary between 50-80 miles, include 9,000-15,000 feet of climbing, and take 7-14 hours to complete. PMBAR is held deep in the Pisgah National Forest, one of the most beautiful, rugged, and unforgiving areas in the nation. There will be little to no water or food support on course. events.title: Old Fort Fifty
events.description: The Old Fort Fifty will be held on the rugged, legendary trails that have made the area famous in the mountain bike world while also incorporating some newer trails recently built by the G5 Trail Collective. While the 30.9 mile distance is on the shorter side for an endurance race, don't fool yourself into thinking this is going to be a walk in the park. You will be served up a heaping helping of elevation gain, climbing 4874 feet and descending an equal amount over fast and technical chunky terrain as well as some super omega flow. There will be two rest areas along the way (Mile 13 and 23.5) stocked with plenty of water and snacks. The Old Fort Fifty will be open to cyclists AND runners! events.title: Pisgah Enduro
events.description: High-speed East Coast technical rocky rooty singletrack ENDURO racing in Pisgah National Forest, around Old Fort, along the steep escarpment of the Blue Ridge Mountains. With dizzying vertical descents to quad-crushing climbs, you will ride a roller coaster that puts this region on the map for the downhill minded. The venue is an actual Summer Camp. There’s a lake, pump track, post-race cookout, and more! Choose bunkhouse or car/tent camping and spend the weekend racing and enjoying life! The course starts in the shadow of the highest peak East of the Mississippi , Mount Mitchell, on the legendary Heartbreak Ridge trail. events.title: Pisgah Monster-Cross Challenge
events.description: The Pisgah Monster-Cross Challenge is the premiere all-road racing event in the region. Participants are challenged to complete a 69.2 mile course with 8,777’of climbing along scenic gravel and paved roads. The riders will be treated to some of the finest gravel roads in the Pisgah and Nantahala National Forests, which is a one-of-a-kind opportunity in the racing world. Monster-Cross is a dream gravel endurance event where keen race tactics and strategy, along with overall fitness, proper gear selection, and sheer luck are key to success. There will be three Rest Areas along the way that will be stocked with water, food (PB&J, fruit, salty snacks, sweet snacks, bars), first aid, and neutral mechanical support. events.description: Membership forms must be filled out and dues must be paid each calendar year. Please fill out this form and submit your annual membership dues of $30. Additional adult members in the same household are $15/person. U23 and junior members are FREE. Fill out a separate membership form for each family member. events.description: The Pisgah 111 is the quintessential crusher of a cross-country endurance MTB race. Racers follow a 65.1 mile course with 10,200' feet of climbing along the most iconic trails and gravel roads known in Pisgah National Forest. Just peek at the course map and list of trails and you’ll immediately get chills just thinking about the epic scenery and terrain you’ll encounter. There will be FOUR rest areas (at three locations) for the Pisgah 111 that will be stocked with water, food (PB&J, fruit, salty snacks, sweet snacks, bars), first aid, and neutral mechanical support. Riders may send drop bags to each rest area. Be sure to read the information below, too.
